'''Grav-carts''' were a type of vehicle. [[Spice/Legends|Spice]] [[Miner/Legends|miners]] on [[Sevarcos II]] used grav-carts to transport spice-encrusted rocks to [[Mining refinery platform|refining platforms]].<ref name="FTS">{{JournalCite|2|The Free-Trader's Guide to Sevarcos}}</ref>
